payload.reason: The evidence discusses a nonsymbolic text representation model that does not rely on traditional segmentation or tokenization methods, suggesting that it does not have a conventional elementary unit of text like words or tokens.

claims.text: The model introduced is completely nonsymbolic and does not require segmentation or tokenization methods that identify words or other symbolic units in text.
The approach allows for the representation of text without relying on traditional units like words, indicating a lack of an elementary unit of text.
Character n-grams are used to represent text without tokenization, further supporting the absence of a conventional elementary unit.
